sources.snippet: Mage-Flow An Efficient Native-Resolution Foundation Model for Image Generation and Editing Mage-Flow is a compact 4B-scale generative stack for efficient text-to-image generation and instruction-based image editing.

sources.title: MageFlow Edit GGUF Pipeline - GitHub
sources.snippet: An enterprise-grade, high-performance instruction-based image editing pipeline powered by the Mage-Flow-Edit GGUF 4-step Turbo model (mageflow-edit-turbo-nvfp4.gguf, 2.37 GB) and Ollama (llama3.2:3b). This pipeline transforms reference images based on natural language editing instructions, such as applying golden-hour sunset lighting and autumn environment shifts with native-resolution fidelity.

sources.title: Microsoft Model: microsoft/Mage-Flow-Edit-Turbo — onlylabs
sources.snippet: Together with native-resolution packing and a fused-kernel training infrastructure, this shared stack powers two model instantiations: Mage-Flow for text-to-image generation and Mage-Flow-Edit for instruction-based image editing. Each ships in Base, RL-aligned, and 4-step Turbo variants.
